title: Cocycle and identity laws for normalized ringed-topos derived composition
statement:
Let $X_0\xrightarrow f X_1\xrightarrow g X_2\xrightarrow h X_3$ be morphisms of ringed topoi presented by small sites, with structural maps between sheaves of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $R_f=Rf_*$, and similarly for the other morphisms. Let $\kappa_{g,f}:R_{gf}\xrightarrow{\sim}R_gR_f$ be the K-injective normalized comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. Then, suppressing functor associators,
$$(R_h\kappa_{g,f})\circ\kappa_{h,gf}=(\kappa_{h,g}R_f)\circ\kappa_{hg,f}.$$
The identity comparisons $\epsilon_X:R_{\mathrm{id}_X}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}$ are induced by termwise identity direct image, and satisfy
$$(\epsilon_{X_1}R_f)\circ\kappa_{\mathrm{id}_{X_1},f}=1_{R_f},\qquad(R_f\epsilon_{X_0})\circ\kappa_{f,\mathrm{id}_{X_0}}=1_{R_f}.$$
These laws also apply when one or more morphisms are coefficient changes on the identity underlying topos.
